scope: Topology-resolved KEYGL5 NET SYNC firmware, application and WidgetGroups enrichment

grounding.evidence: Retained CBusEdlt classfile order and direct OEM transport tests
grounding.finding: Direct evidence establishes the eligibility guards, firmware then applications then WidgetGroups order, CAL payloads, selector tag, decoding and optional-failure invalidation behavior.

grounding.evidence: Routed standard CAL RECALL/STORE and Reply Network matcher tests
grounding.finding: Existing point-to-point route evidence establishes one-to-six bridges and exact first-bridge, remaining-hop, remote-unit, parameter, tag and fragmented-count correlation.

claimed_behavior: NET SYNC applies the same non-error MMI, configured/fresh KEYGL5 and unique known IDENTIFY4 guards on direct and routed networks.
FirmwareVersion, Application/Application2 and WidgetGroups are read in retained order and committed only to the addressed network on the captured PCI generation.
Direct and neighbouring-route responses cannot advance a routed selector or recall; incomplete optional reads retire the generation without replay.
acceptance: Transport tests pin exact one/six-bridge wire bytes, route isolation, selector ACK correlation, fragmented recalls, decoding and invalid-route refusal.
Service tests pin complete routed MMI/identity preflight, all four cached metadata fields, target-network-only commit and the native NET SYNC envelope.
limits: This is a bounded composition of separately retained direct eDLT behavior and routed standard-CAL behavior; no exact native bridged KEYGL5 capture is claimed.
No live bridge or remote KEYGL5 hardware acceptance, display behavior, persistence or power-cycle behavior is claimed.
WidgetGroups is a static mapping and does not read a display's pre-existing dynamic-label cache.
